scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm ci && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma db push && npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts && node dist/index.js
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
